name: vicarius
title: Vicarius vRx
description: Imports remediation status from Vicarius vRx via the External Data API. VICARIUS_MODE picks the view: 'assets' (asset inventory and OS/IP metadata), 'cves' (active vulnerabilities grouped by vulnerabilityId — each emitted as a Faraday vuln on every affected host), or 'patches' (missing patches per endpoint). Configure VICARIUS_API_URL and VICARIUS_TOKEN as agent env vars (the token is sent as the 'Vicarius-Token' header). Use VICARIUS_FROM / VICARIUS_SIZE for pagination. Read-only today — patch execution and external-findings ingest are not exposed by the vRx PAT scope.
